Polling interval help: How often devices without WebSocket are polled. Devices with WebSocket get a ping at the same interval and count as offline without an answer. Also the wait before a new connection attempt.
Max retry attempts help: Intentos de conexión por interrupción. Después se intenta una vez por hora. 0 = reintentar sin límite.
Exponential backoff help: Wait a little longer after each failed reconnect.
Auto discovery help: Off: only known devices and devices added by IP. Searching in the "Config manager" tab ("Devices" in older Admin versions) still works.
Delay to bundle commands per device: Delay to bundle commands per device
Bundle delay help: Changes to the same device within this time are sent as one command. 0 = never bundle.
